rights_findings: plbbl root MIT expressly excludes unlicensed paper figures under references, original THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES says permission for 30 PNG and 3 contact sheets is absent.
orange2ai commercial/proprietary use of the original style specification or derivative style requires paid license, unlike generic MIT usage.
GZ-L owned photo stylization instructions MIT, but source photos and any image-provider outputs require authorization and separate rights.
nontrigger_notes: Academic method diagrams are not general scientific quantitative plots or medical figures.
Photo-to-impasto landscape does not fully satisfy environment scene design/painting independent of a reference photograph.
Pen wash photo stylization is a specific media expression method, not verified actual analog painting ability.
Editorial orange-line is a specific proprietary style system subject to dual licensing, not a universal commercial usage permission.
